description: c115 re-author: boot to STAGE_CITRAINING via --skip-intro and arm --debug-mount-bike one-shot. Post-setupCreateProps hook scans g_Vars.activeprops for an OBJTYPE_HOVERBIKE and mounts player 0 on the first match (one-shot per boot). Note: CITRAINING does NOT spawn the player adjacent to its hoverbike, so the mount is expected to be REJECTED unless a future change moves player 0 to the bike pad or the bike to the player. The test surfaces this as a finding via the BOOT: --debug-mount-bike consumed result=REJECTED / MOUNTED line. --no-net bakes in to close firewall focus-steal class.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --skip-intro routes to STAGE_CITRAINING (0x26). --debug-mount-bike armed; bootDebugMountBikeTick scans activeprops post-load (lvframenum >= 4).
settle so bootDebugMountBikeTick can walk activeprops and either mount or report REJECTED / no-bike-on-stage

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: manual mount attempt #1 (in case bike is nearby but mount-during-load failed)
settle for one-shot consumption (lvframenum > 120 timeout in bootDebugMountBikeTick)
scripted exit -- findings live in the BOOT: --debug-mount-bike consumed line regardless of mount success
